title: fix(app-shell): the condition builder offers user.isPlatformAdmin instead of user.isAdmin and user.role
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbLtK4TajQZzgz4LPGqpe79W)_

Fixes #28833

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:元数据管理里的条件行构建器(Studio / Setup 的「可见条件」等)默认主题列表,把 `user.isAdmin` 换成 `user.isPlatformAdmin`,去掉 `user.role`;原始 CEL 编辑器的示例占位文字同样改教 `user.isPlatformAdmin`。新增一个测试,把列表里每个 `user.*` 主题拿到真实的表达式作用域里求值。
- **为什么改**:浏览器端绑定的用户对象(`buildExpressionUser`)根本没有 `isAdmin`,选它建出的行一求值就报错;`user.role` 是 better-auth 的旧字段,平台管理员读出来也是 `user`。两者都建不出「仅管理员可见」的门。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 `ui/packages/app-shell` 一个源文件里的两个常量和测试,不动 spec、服务端和已存的元数据。已存的 `user.isAdmin` / `user.role` 条件照常以行模式打开,主题原样保留,不会被改写。实测 `examples/**` 与平台应用里没有使用这两个主题的条件。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx` 的 `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS` 与 `CEL_EXAMPLE_CLAUSES`;再看新测试 `ConditionBuilder.contextSubjectsBag.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.contextSubjectsBag.test.ts`,应 1 个文件 8 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`CONTEXT_SUBJECTS`, the row builder's default context subjects, now offers `record.id`, `user.id`, `user.email` and `user.isPlatformAdmin`:

- **`user.isAdmin` → `user.isPlatformAdmin`.** The `user` object `buildExpressionScope` binds (under `user`, `current_user`, `ctx.user` and `os.user`) is `buildExpressionUser`'s output. On both branches its members are `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`, `isPlatformAdmin` and `positions`, and there is no `isAdmin`. `isPlatformAdmin` is the platform-admin signal. It is `false` on the anonymous branch, so a row on it answers instead of faulting.
- **`user.role` dropped.** It is in the bag, but it is better-auth's legacy `sys_user.role` scalar. ObjectStack never writes it (ADR-0068 D2), and it reads `user` for a signed-in platform admin too.
- **`CEL_EXAMPLE_CLAUSES`**, the source of the raw editor's placeholder, teaches `user.isPlatformAdmin` instead of `user.isAdmin`.

Both constants are now exported so the new test can read them. Neither is re-exported by the package entry, so the published surface does not move. `conditionScope.ts` needs no edit. It names no `user` member: it hands the server tier `RECORD_CONDITION_SUBJECTS` (`record.id` only), the client tier inherits `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS`, and its root lists (`CLIENT_CONDITION_ROOTS`) are roots, not members. So it follows the list by construction.

The card says a row on `user.isAdmin` "never opens". The row faults, and what a fault does depends on which gate evaluates the row. An action's `visible` / `disabled` fail closed (`useCondition` with `throwOnError`, `ActionEngine`), and navigation withholds (`evaluateNavigationVisibility`), so on those the gate never opens. An object field's `visible` goes through `evaluateVisibility`, which fails open by documented design, so there it opens for everyone. Either way it never means "admins only".

## Tests

- `ConditionBuilder.contextSubjectsBag.test.ts` (new, 8 cases, `unit` project). It reads the member list off `buildExpressionUser` for a platform admin, a member and an anonymous visitor. It evaluates every offered `user.*` subject against `createExpressionEvaluator` (the real bag) on the evaluator's fail-closed seam. And it checks that a "`user.isPlatformAdmin` is true" row opens for the admin only. Controls: `user.isAdmin` faults on every branch, and `user.role` resolves to `user` for an admin and is not offered. The example placeholder's `user` clause evaluates on every branch.
- `ConditionBuilder.subjectVocabulary.test.tsx`: the default-subject shape now lists `user.isPlatformAdmin` and neither removed subject.
- `ConditionBuilder.contextSubjects.test.tsx`: the "still offers `user.*`" case holds `user.isPlatformAdmin`. Its lint leg passes for `user.isAdmin` too, because the engine lint accepts any member of an accepted root. That is why the new pin evaluates against the bag instead.
- `ConditionWidget.conditionSubjects.test.tsx`: one doc comment's example spelling.

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, at 8f66ea84)</summary>

- `user.isAdmin` re-added to `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS`: 3 failed, 5 passed (each branch: `expected [ 'id', 'name', 'email', 'role', …(2) ] to include 'isAdmin'`). Restored, blob equal to HEAD.
- `CEL_EXAMPLE_CLAUSES` put back to `user.isAdmin`: 1 failed (the placeholder case), 7 passed. Restored, blob `90d12c3f` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Stored conditions, measured with `git grep` at `2a4c0034` over `examples`, `ui/examples`, `ui/apps` and `packages` (non-test, non-markdown) for `user` / `current_user` / `ctx.user` / `os.user` with `.isAdmin` or `.role`. No authored condition uses either subject. The one hit is a test fixture, `packages/metadata/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-17.1-built-bare-root-predicates.artifact.json` (`current_user.role == "admin"`). The other hits are doc comments in `plugin-auth`, `spec` and `runtime` that describe the legacy scalar.
- A stored `user.isAdmin` or `user.role` row still opens in row mode. The builder appends an out-of-vocabulary subject as its own option, as for `org.id` (`ConditionBuilder.contextSubjects.test.tsx`). Nothing is rewritten on open.
- The bag also carries `user.name` and `user.positions`, which are not offered. Adding subjects is outside this card.

## Verification

All on the final head `457b72bb` (`origin/main` `892eb668` merged, which carries #28832), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` plus formula, sdui-parser, lint and client (64 tasks, exit 0), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- Every app-shell test file naming `ConditionBuilder`, `conditionScope`, `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS`, `celExampleForRoots` or `buildExpressionUser` (`git grep -l`, `--maxWorkers=2`): 60 files, 667 tests passed. The same set without `buildExpressionUser` at `8f66ea84`, before the merge: 53 files, 611 passed. CI's Test UI runs the rest of app-shell.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc` programs, the test one included): exit 0 at `457b72bb` and at `8f66ea84`.
- ESLint on the 5 changed ts/tsx files: 0 errors. The two `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings on the newly exported constants are the same class as the file's existing ones (`RECORD_CONDITION_ROOTS`, `celExampleForRoots`).
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 34 of 34 run at `457b72bb`, each exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` under the lock), including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` and the PR-body gates with this body as `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`. `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Also 34 of 34 at `8f66ea84`.
